subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should this PR's doctor migration be accepted as the upgrade path for shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` configs?
rationale: The PR intentionally removes a shipped accepted config value and changes upgrade behavior for existing configs, which is compatibility-sensitive even though it preserves the previous no-export runtime result.

options.title: Accept the doctor migration
options.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after normal maintainer review.

options.title: Keep grpc as a config contract
options.body: Pause or close this PR and sponsor the larger real gRPC exporter implementation instead.

recommendation.title: Accept the doctor migration
recommendation.body: Merge the stricter config contract with the legacy repair path after normal maintainer review.
